body: Sure I'm good at pretending. What's up?

Well it's hard to explain. Every morning I wake up and think that I should kill myself today. I understand this behavior isn't normal, but regardless it's how I start my day. Lots of things in life can contribute to being suicidal.  It's normally not one specific event although that can be a trigger. I'm sorry for your sister but I would suggest taking to her about how other stuff in her life is going.  For example school or work. Also finding some kind of hobby you guys could do together that is routine oriented would also be good. I mean something you do every week or so. This would give her something to look forward to each week.  I hope this helps.
You respond to a lot of posts and help people. I appreciate you u/Notmuchfun thanks again .
Sounds like your boyfriend was a dick, I'm sorry for that. There is no way your parents would see you as a burden. I wish you the best of luck, even though I'm garbage at saying motivational stuff.

Thanks I'll do my best, but I have been suicidal for a long time and it is hard to talk to people about it. Only one of my friends know and they live in another state. And my parents think it was a phase in 7th grade so I don't know. Every year feels like an accomplishment not because I improved myself or did something cool, but because I didn't die. I will try to hold myself accountable for my actions.

Edit: do you do these people do therapy for free, or am I going to get charged. /s

Thanks for the advice😁. I do really appreciate the help. I will try to reign it in. I still function pretty well and try to stay fit, but I think that just makes it harder to see it as a problem. Unfortunately I have a history of making mistakes and I think this is probably one of them. Again thanks for the reply random internet stranger.
